title: Markdown-only validation omits tests that consume documented contract tables
outcome: Markdown contract-table changes receive the checks that consume them, while ordinary prose keeps a proportionate validation path.
acceptance: Identify the current tests that consume Markdown and correct the claim that only the link checker reads Markdown; keep AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md identical and review-command guidance consistent.

Record and validate a bounded check-selection rule for edits to consumed contract tables versus ordinary prose, preserving existing effective receipt tests and applicable authority-text review requirements.
disposal_reason: Premise gone: no test reads a Markdown file any more. A grep for include_str and read_to_string of .md finds none; a4c488e3 and Greg's rules-greg-no-instruction-file-tests-2026-11-07 removed such tests. So no Markdown-only change can affect a test that reads documented tables. Closed by Engram::Fable after a read-only triage, under rules-greg-close-senseless-tasks-2026-11-08 and Greg's #803.
